# Android (kotlin) parallel of compile_bubbletea_locale_override.txt:
# `locale("es-MX") { ... }` threads the literal locale to i18n.* stdlib calls
# in the subtree at compile time. Locks the end-to-end behavior so it doesn't
# regress alongside the Go output path.

sngl compile --platform=android --lang=kotlin --opt=main=true --out=out app.sngl
exists out/app/src/main/java/test/sngl/app/MainScreen.kt

# I18n Kotlin runtime is imported in MainScreen.kt.
grep 'import us.duckfam.git.jonathan.sngl.i18n.I18n' out/app/src/main/java/test/sngl/app/MainScreen.kt

# locale("es-MX") threads to I18n.numberInt as the first arg.
grep 'I18n\.numberInt\("es-MX",' out/app/src/main/java/test/sngl/app/MainScreen.kt

# Provider-block var `price` is promoted to a Compose state field.
grep 'price' out/app/src/main/java/test/sngl/app/MainScreen.kt

-- app.sngl --
output { kotlin { android } }

component main {
    var n = 1234
    locale("es-MX") {
        var price = i18n.numberInt(n, "decimal")
        text(value=price)
    }
}
